elsewhere.note: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for…
burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.
For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.
Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it: wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, bandaged, or soothed with oil.
